SHILPAMED.name: Shilpa Medicare
lines: New oncology GMP facility started in June 2026, lifting CDMO capacity about 35%; oncology injection ANDA approved May 2026.
July 2026: subsidiary bought 30.4% of Gate2Brain for €7 mn; Latin America biosimilar licensing pact signed March 2026.

SETL.name: Standard Engineering Technology
lines: Greenfield plant taking capacity to ₹4,000 cr — Phase 1 (₹2,000 cr) live by Apr 2027, full by Apr 2028 — on a ₹130 cr two-year capex, order book above ₹1,000 cr.
Scigenics and C2C buys open oil & gas, nuclear and F&B; a Mar 5 UAE distribution pact covers the Middle East.

INDSWFTLAB.name: Ind-Swift Laboratories
lines: Derabassi site received an EU-GMP certificate (valid 3 years) from Hungary's regulator in December 2025, opening regulated European formulation markets.
Jammu facility upgrade to EU-GMP and PIC/S standards, about ₹45 cr, with approval targeted by early 2028.

KABRAEXTRU.name: Kabra Extrusion Technik
lines: Board cleared UAE and Vietnam subsidiaries on Sep 5 with up to ₹750 cr for battery-pack capacity (₹500 cr in Vietnam); a Vietnamese passenger-car OEM issued a Letter of Nomination Sep 7.
GEON's high-voltage four-wheeler packs start at Pune this September; batteries were already 56% of Q1FY27 revenue.

BLISSGVS.name: Bliss GVS Pharma
lines: Change of control: Anupam Rasayan is buying 43.3% for ₹1,369 cr at ₹299/share, plus a 26% open offer — up to 74.2% ownership pulls the suppository maker into a specialty-chem group.
Post-offer advertisement on Sep 2 wound up the open offer, clearing the path to deal completion and control transfer.

WELCORP.name: Welspun Corp
lines: Record $1.8 bn (₹17,200 cr) US pipe order from Arkansas plant, executing FY28-FY29; global order book hit ~$4.4 bn (₹42,100 cr).
Order announced 21 Aug lifted the stock to record highs; no new October trigger found.

SAKAR.name: Sakar Healthcare
lines: 14 new oncology product approvals across the EU, UK and Canada via seven partners (Sep 1); Accord's EMA site variations take technology transfers approved at Sakar's plant to six of eight.
Analyst and investor plant visits on Sep 17–18, followed by the AGM on Sep 22.

MANINDS.name: Man Industries India
lines: ₹1,000 cr fresh line-pipe orders (₹300 cr India, ₹700 cr Saudi arm NPC), 6-9 month execution, lifting unexecuted order book to ₹4,100 cr; $102M 100% NPC acquisition adds capacity.
QatarEnergy preferred LSAW manufacturer listing (Aug 14) opens GCC large-diameter pipe bids.

SKYGOLD.name: Sky Gold & Diamonds
lines: Acquired 100% of Purvi Gems & Jewellery (completed Oct 7; board approved Sep 18) for up to ₹9 cr cash, adding lightweight and studded jewellery capacity.
Purvi's provisional FY26 turnover was ₹103.4 cr.

CYIENTDLM.name: Cyient DLM
lines: Order book at record ₹2,813.7 crore at Sep 2026, up ₹214.8 crore QoQ from ₹2,598.9 crore; book-to-bill 1.6x.
Aerospace revenue up 62% YoY; Q1 FY27 fresh order inflow was ₹551.9 crore.

RATNAVEER.name: Ratnaveer Precision
lines: ₹472 crore Vadodara copper clad laminate (CCL) plant, about 60% complete, commercial production due Nov 2026; targets ₹5,000 crore revenue in five years.
₹330 crore rights issue at ₹264 funds it; allotted 10 Sep 2026, listed 15 Sep.

GMMPFAUDLR.name: GMM Pfaudler
lines: Record order backlog of ₹2,289 cr, up about 20% year on year, with roughly 70% executable within 10-12 months.
Q1 FY27 order intake was a record ₹1,007 cr, reported 5 August 2026.

INDORAMA.name: Indo Rama Synthetics India
lines: Board approved ₹200 cr specialty filament and fibre expansion at Butibori, Nagpur (16 Oct 2026), commercial operation in 12-18 months.
Executed via subsidiary Indorama Ventures Yarns, funded by term loan plus internal accruals.

RGL.name: Renaissance Global
lines: Renaissance Jewellery Middle East FZCO agreed strategic investment in Naman Trading FZC (Sep 1, 2026), entering Middle East branded jewellery.
US tariff on Indian jewellery held at 10% under new Section 301 regime from Jul 24, 2026; third Jean Dousset store opened in San Francisco.

AEROFLEX.name: Aeroflex Industries
lines: Board approved ₹202 cr capex on Oct 14: ₹124 cr lifting SS hose capacity 20M to 30M metres, ₹78 cr doubling liquid cooling skid assembly to 30,000 units, by March 2028.
Targets ₹500-550 cr incremental peak revenue.

RPEL.name: Raghav Productivity Enhancers
lines: 80:20 JV with TRL Krosaki (RPEL TRLK Silicatech, Odisha) for a 350,000 MTPA silica ramming mass plant, ~₹100 cr initial outlay, announced Sep 4-8, 2026.
Brownfield expansion lifts capacity to 534,000 MTPA from 414,000 MTPA by Oct 1, 2026.

JINDALSAW.name: Jindal Saw
lines: API licences for seamless pipes restored Jun 24, 2026, valid to Jun 2029, reopening certified oil and gas orders; Nashik unit ramping from Sep-Oct toward 70-80k tonnes a quarter from Q3 FY27.
Jal Jeevan Mission extended to 2028; $1.3 bn order book and MENA plants planned.

BLUESTONE.name: BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle
lines: ₹400–500 cr to add 80 stores this fiscal on a 352-store base, three-quarters on high streets; 39% same-store sales growth and a ₹12,000 cr revenue target within four years.
₹25 cr follow-on into lab-grown brand Ethera; 15th AGM cleared all resolutions Sep 14.

MOREPENLAB.name: Morepen Laboratories
lines: ₹825 cr global CDMO mandate now in full commercial supply — first ₹50 cr dispatched in Q1FY27, ~₹225 cr guided for Q2, reactor capacity headed for 1,000 KL.
Phase 1 expansion completed ahead of schedule on Sep 7, taking capacity 535 → 614 KL and the stock to a 52-week high of ₹122.

ENTERO.name: Entero Healthcare
lines: Acquisition-led MedTech and distribution expansion: Anand Chemiceutics (51.51%, Feb 2026) and Vishal Surgicals business buy, targeting ₹1,000 cr+ revenue from M&A.
Vishal Surgicals deal (up to ~₹9 cr) due to close by 31 Dec 2026.

NOVARTIND.name: Novartis India
lines: Board cleared a ~₹1,250 cr buyout of the Minipress/Minipres trademarks from Pfizer — Minipress XL does ₹228.6 cr revenue, 6.3% four-year CAGR (IQVIA MAT Jul 2026).
Sep 8 exclusive rights to retina drugs Accentrix and Pagenax from Novartis Healthcare for ₹10 cr upfront; shares hit a record ₹2,588 on Sep 10.

ASIANENE.name: Asian Energy Services
lines: Oilmax merger (117 AESL shares per 10 OEPL, 99.99% assent Jun 12) adds upstream oil-asset ownership; order book ₹1,754 cr, Kuiper's overseas arm running at US$60–70 mn a year.
₹187.62 cr GSECL EPC order for Ukai's coal handling plant (Jun 22), its first non-Coal India client; NCLT merger clearance targeted Sep–Oct 2026.

DEEPINDS.name: Deep Industries
lines: Order book of ₹3,047 cr (Jun 30, 2026) supported by serial ONGC gas compression wins: ₹83.8 cr (Jun 20), ₹49.1 cr (Jul 7).
₹88.15 cr three-year ONGC Balol GGS-1 (Mehsana) gas compression award announced Sep 8, 2026.

RUBICON.name: Rubicon Research
lines: Pithampur won USFDA filing approval a month after its Jun 29–Jul 3 inspection, commercial ramp from Q1 CY2027; East Brunswick plant bought from InvaTech for US$2.9 mn on Jul 22.
86 approved US products, 88% commercialised, 24 more under FDA review; FY27 EBITDA margin guidance lifted to at least 23%.

PRABHA.name: Prabha Energy Limited
lines: Jharia CBM Block-I — ₹1,800 cr revenue-share contract with BCCL, 25 BCM gas in place, projected ₹1,424 cr annual turnover; five core holes and test wells drilled, hydro-fracturing under way.
Coal Ministry has pushed for first CBM production by December 2026; Aug 31 corporate presentation and Sep 8 AGM re-lit the stock.

AHCL.name: Anlon Healthcare Limited
lines: Capacity roll-up: Apiqo Organics (67.48% for ₹5.40 cr, Jan 9) and Bizotic Lifescience took installed API capacity to 1,400–1,600 MTPA, with a share swap of 8.59 cr shares at ₹17.85 making both wholly owned.
Sep 5 AGM cleared the capital increase and preferential issue; 30% revenue CAGR target.

SSWL.name: Steel Strips Wheels
lines: Board approved a ₹1,400 cr greenfield plant at Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar: 25 lakh alloy wheels (₹815 cr), 15 lakh steel wheels (₹410 cr), hot-stamping line (₹175 cr).
Announced 23 Oct; stock hit the 20% upper circuit. Project spread over about 60 months.

COMSYN.name: Commercial Syn Bags Limited
lines: ₹83 cr expansion over FY26–28 — a new unit under subsidiary Comsyn International plus Unit-SEZ additions — on a 24,530 MTPA base already running at 91% utilisation.
Techtex expansion (+1,500 MTPA) went commercial Jul 22; Sep 17 promoter warrant conversion brought in ₹8.71 cr at ₹72/share.

FINCABLES.name: Finolex Cables
lines: New 4 million fibre-km optical fibre capacity due on stream by Q3 FY27, aimed at AI and data-centre led fibre demand.
Selling prices raised in May 2026 on high copper; copper-linked pricing supports revenue.

VSSL.name: Vardhman Special Steels
lines: Ludhiana rolling capacity raised to 270,000 tpa via new reheating furnace (March 2026); environmental clearance obtained for expansion to 280,000 tpa.
Forging and machining project with Aichi Steel on schedule; 500,000-tonne greenfield plant planned.

INOXINDIA.name: INOX India
lines: Record ₹532 cr Q1FY27 order inflow took the order book to an all-time high ₹1,686 cr (exports ₹1,140 cr+) — 22 cryogenic modules for CERN's HL-LHC, an ITER order, first semiconductor tanks for Dholera.
LNG execution underway: Bahamas mini-LNG terminal tanks delivered, Cochin Shipyard marine LNG fuel tanks in progress.

MARINE.name: Marine Electricals India
lines: Data-centre power-distribution orders keep stacking: ₹376 cr (Jul 24, Siemens/Titagarh/Princeton), ₹399 cr (Aug 31, Princeton/Classic Electric).
Fresh ₹229.7 cr Digital Edge order (15-month delivery) on Sep 1, then ₹80.8 cr from DXDC and Micron on Sep 4.

WSTCSTPAPR.name: West Coast Paper Mills
lines: No fresh catalyst found; 12 Oct 20% upper-circuit looks like momentum buying, with no new order, capex or policy announcement.

WELSPUNLIV.name: Welspun Living
lines: Export incentive: DGFT extended RoDTEP to 31 Dec 2026 (Notification 41/2026-27, 30 Sep), existing rates and caps unchanged.
RoSCTL for apparel and made-ups also extended to 31 Dec 2026, supporting home-textile export refunds.

VENUSPIPES.name: Venus Pipes & Tubes
lines: Board cleared a ₹372 cr preferential issue on Sep 16 at ₹1,670 to 18 investors — WhiteOak, Tata funds, Kotak Life, Ashish Kacholia — to prepay debt; EGM Oct 8.
Seamless capacity up six-fold to 20,400 MTPA, fittings plant live May 26; ₹185 cr data-centre spools LOI, spooling line Q3FY27.

IOLCP.name: IOL Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals
lines: ₹495 cr capex unveiled Sep 9: ₹350 cr backward-integrated ibuprofen unit at Barnala lifts capacity 12,000 → 18,000 MTPA by Dec 2027 (utilisation 95%), plus ₹110 cr formulations CDMO, ₹35 cr specialty chemicals.
CDMO (1,500 mn tablets/yr) and specialty unit — long-term tolling deal with a global chemical major — go live Q3FY27.

SBCL.name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls
lines: Forward integration into EV busbars and connectors — Pune Phase-I plant cleared MPCB consent on Jul 16, ₹20–25 cr capex, full readiness targeted October FY27, orders already in hand.
Sep 2 AGM approved an AoA amendment enabling future capital raising to fund shunt-resistor and busbar expansion.

MMP.name: MMP Industries
lines: New composite insulator arm MMP Electricals: ₹35-40 cr committed capex, revenue targeted ₹18-20 cr in FY27 and ₹45-50 cr in FY28; Phase II lifts range to 765 kV.
Export push: ~$100,000 Venezuela order (21 Aug) and Nepal polymer insulator supplies started; PGCIL vendor registration awaited.

RAYMOND.name: Raymond Ltd
lines: Aerospace pivot: ₹214.71 cr preferential warrants (33.29 lakh at ₹645) to Minerva Ventures cleared Oct 3, 75% earmarked for aerospace, auto and defence acquisitions; promoter warrants at ₹497 in July.
Sep 11 aerospace order: 300+ part numbers, 37,000+ components a year, ~₹33 cr annual potential; order book above ₹5,960 cr.

SYRMA.name: Syrma SGS Technology
lines: Naidupeta PCB plant (₹1,595 cr, 51:49 with Korea's Shinhyup) due for commissioning by October 2026, backed by ₹856 cr Andhra Pradesh incentive.
Syrma Kaga Electronics JV (60% stake, Aug 18) for Japanese OEMs; Elemaster JV Bengaluru plant inaugurated Sep 2.

GCSL.name: Gretex Corporate Services
lines: No fresh company announcement found; the run to a 52-week high looks momentum-driven. Subsidiary Gretex Share Broking's proposed IPO is background only.

FILATEX.name: Filatex India
lines: ₹300 cr textile-to-textile recycling plant (26,750 tpa) at Dahej, commissioning slipped to October 2026 from September.
₹235 cr polyester filament yarn expansion also due for commissioning around September 2026.

DIVISLAB.name: Divi's Laboratories Limited
lines: Peptide build-out — additional 3,000-litre SPPS reactors, GLP-1 API supplies to innovators slated to start FY27, ₹2,034 cr capital work-in-progress at Jun 30, Kakinada Unit-3 now live on backward integration.
Iodine contrast media commercialised with a first customer, substantial volumes guided for coming months; stock hit a record ₹9,615.

SOLARA.name: Solara Active Pharma Sciences
lines: Rights issue raised ~₹445 cr in three tranches; final ~₹100 cr call received Q1 FY27, cutting net debt to ₹479 cr (30 Jun 2026).
CRISIL upgraded rating to BBB+/A2 on 24 Jun 2026 on deleveraging.

MARKSANS.name: Marksans Pharma Limited
lines: European front-end build-out — QliniQ B.V. (Netherlands, June) and ABCnow GmbH (Germany, closed Jul 20, ~₹10 cr) acquired within 60 days, targeting ₹4,000 cr revenue in 2–3 years.
Goa ex-Teva plant, ₹200 cr expansion to 8 bn units, utilisation guided to 80–85% by FY27 after a zero-483 US FDA inspection.

TFCILTD.name: Tourism Finance Corporation of India
lines: Targeting ₹3,000 cr loan sanctions in FY27 versus ₹2,002 cr in FY26, with ~₹500 cr from smaller cities and emerging tourism destinations; AUM seen ~₹2,800 cr.
Hospitality lending push reported Jul 27-28, 2026; capital adequacy 55.53% and board-approved borrowing of up to ₹1,000 cr give room to scale.

AETHER.name: Aether Industries Limited
lines: Site 5 Panoli — 31-acre greenfield, 16 planned blocks — began commercial production Jun 26, 2026, backed by take-or-pay contracts with Baker Hughes (5-year, ₹400 cr at full utilisation), Saudi Aramco and SEQENS.
Jul 31 exclusive research programme with Dow India on silicone manufacturing technologies at Surat; stock touched a ₹1,717 52-week high.

DIACABS.name: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited
lines: Order book ~₹3,688 cr after a ₹435.71 cr HT/LT cable order (Jul 6) for 310 MW Hyderabad data centres, deliveries Aug 2026–Mar 2027; 8th MV/EHV line lifted capacity to 1,050 km/month.
₹168.62 cr capex cleared Aug 19 for a 42,024 km/yr LV cable plant (FY28); ₹179.43 cr Adani Electricity Mumbai order Sep 3.

WINDLAS.name: Windlas Biotech
lines: Plant-6 at Dehradun commercialises by end-H1 FY27, lifting revenue capacity to ₹1,100 cr (₹1,000 cr oral solids + ₹100 cr injectables); CDMO is ~74% of revenue.
Exports jumped 79% YoY in Q1 FY27 across Southeast Asia, CIS and Africa, on the back of ₹73 cr FY26 capex.

NEULANDLAB.name: Neuland Laboratories
lines: First commercial peptide module commissioned at Bonthapally the week of Sep 15 — 7,000 L reactor capacity, $30 mn invested with ~$30 mn firm commitments; module two (up to 18,000 L) tracking ahead with an anchor customer.
Board cleared ₹126 cr on Sep 7 for 134 acres at Kakinada, ROFR on 66 more.

PAYTM.name: One 97 Communications
lines: NPCI's Sep 15 circular allows up to 0.4% MDR on UPI merchant payments above ₹2,000 (capped ₹300) from Oct 15, opening a fresh revenue pool on previously free transactions; stock hit a 52-week high of ₹1,855.50.
Sep 9 launch of Paytm Intelligence (Pi), enterprise AI agents for banks and insurers in India and the UAE.

GANDHAR.name: Gandhar Oil Refinery
lines: No confirmed catalyst for the October run-up; capex (5 acres at Taloja, ~30% / 60,000 kL addition) is still unannounced, with no filed order or capex approval.

DOLPHIN.name: Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India)
lines: Cabinet's Jul 31 approval of the ₹84,084 cr Samudra Manthan offshore exploration scheme (to FY31) drives vessel demand; ₹500 cr fleet plan — two DSV/PSVs and two AHTS over 12–15 months.
Prabha DP2 barge already earning on a three-year $32.85 mn (~₹281 cr) lease; Sep 17 rally to ₹683.65.

RML.name: Rane (Madras)
lines: ₹370 cr acquisition of Hindustan Composites' friction business (FY26 revenue ~₹315 cr; Paithan and Bhandara plants; COMPO brand), lifting friction segment past ₹1,000 cr.
Velachery land sale to Canopy Living for ₹361.18 cr funds debt reduction.

HATSUN.name: Hatsun Agro Product
lines: ₹1,000 cr FY27 capex for milk procurement, retail distribution and plant upgrades, targeting 2.4 crore packs/day within 2 years versus 1.84 crore now.
Network of 4,100 HAP Daily outlets and 220 Ibaco ice-cream parlours is being scaled alongside the capex.

KDDL.name: KDDL Ltd
lines: No hard catalyst found; move tracks Ethos luxury-retail expansion (100th boutique, 15 May 2026) and promoter stake sell-down, not a dated deal or approval.

NITINSPIN.name: Nitin Spinners
lines: ₹1,100-1,120 cr two-year capex expanding spinning (+25%) and fabric (+50%) capacity, targeting ~₹1,000 cr extra revenue.
New capacity commissioning in phases through FY27; India-UK and India-EU FTAs seen opening textile export access.

ATHERENERG.name: Ather Energy
lines: ₹2,500 cr raise (₹1,300 cr QIP at ₹1,202, 8x subscribed, plus ₹1,200 cr preferential to Hero MotoCorp and others) funds capacity expansion and R&D.
Aurangabad Factory 3.0 phase one adds 5 lakh units a year, heading to 14.2 lakh units after phase two.

VARROC.name: Varroc Engineering
lines: Aug 20 AGM set a ₹20,000 cr FY31 revenue target with FY27 guided above ₹10,500 cr; FY26 new wins carry ₹3,289 cr annualised peak revenue, 65% EV-linked.
Eight-year ₹800 cr-peak HV e-powertrain contract plus a six-year ~$48 mn/yr bi-directional wall-charger win built in Romania; FY27 capex ₹550 cr.

SMSPHARMA.name: SMS Pharmaceuticals
lines: No order, approval, capex or other hard catalyst found for October 2026; latest dated catalyst located was the Nov 2025 USFDA nod for VKT Pharma's reformulated ranitidine.

AKUMS.name: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals
lines: €200M (₹1,760 cr) European CDMO contract with €100M upfront — first commercial Dapagliflozin supply to Switzerland done, EU-GMP secured for two plants, five targeted by FY28.
Zambia JV (51%, $45M Lusaka plant) guided for $25M supplies over FY27–28; ~₹300 cr FY27 capex on oral solids.

KAPSTON.name: Kapston Services
lines: Entry into B2C home services via new subsidiary Kapston Home Services — Hyderabad app launched Aug 12 with Nagarjuna as brand ambassador, metro roll-out planned across FY27.
No dated order or capex filing behind the September move — the re-rating rests on the B2C pivot beyond B2B facilities management.

WABAG.name: VA Tech Wabag
lines: Record ₹17,234 cr order book after ₹7,471 cr FY26 intake — 4.4x revenue visibility across desalination, industrial and municipal water.
Sep 7 repeat order from Reliance: ₹100–250 cr effluent treatment plant at the Jamnagar Green Energy Giga Complex, 13-month execution.

LAURUSLABS.name: Laurus Labs
lines: CDMO scale-up: 532-acre Vizag pharma complex (Andhra Pradesh allotment, Jul 2025) with US$600 mn planned over 8 years from FY27; CDMO targeted at 50% of revenue versus ~30%.
Vizag 400 KL fermentation facility due by end-2026; Laurus Synthesis merger scheme awaits NCLT (hearing Sep 10, 2026).

WHEELS.name: Wheels India
lines: 50:50 JV with Bosch and Brakes India for electronic CV air systems (compressors, air suspension, parking brakes); agreement executed May 20, 2026, operations from end-2026.
Funding: ₹180 cr preferential issue at ₹1,418/share (Aug 2026) within board-approved ₹400 cr fundraise (Jul 2026).

FCL.name: Fineotex Chemical
lines: US oilfield push: 53.33% of CrudeChem acquired (Dec 2025); Texas capacity raised from 200 to 350 million lbs/yr (8 Jun).
New Delaware subsidiary (24 Sep) targets water-treatment chemicals for data centres and semiconductor plants.

GLAND.name: Gland Pharma
lines: USFDA inspection of Visakhapatnam (VSEZ) sterile oncology site closed Sep 1 with zero Form 483 observations, clearing the facility for regulated-market supply.
Capex of about ₹2,000 cr over five years for PFS, ophthalmic, lyo and vial lines; oncology CMO contract starts FY28.

UNIMECH.name: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing
lines: Long-term supply contract with Austria's FACC for aerospace components (Jun 30, 2026); order book ~₹314 cr versus ~₹100 cr a year earlier.
Board approved ₹750 cr QIP on Aug 3, 2026; ₹72.2 cr NPCIL Tarapur order (Jan 2026) runs to Dec 2028.

SHREEJISPG.name: Shreeji Shipping Global
lines: Fleet build-out: two mini bulk carriers bought for ₹55.66 cr, three more on order for FY27, plus tonnage tax scheme approval.
Time charter with AMNS for MV Sanghi and Kolkata (Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port) operations starting.

TIIL.name: Technocraft Industries (India)
lines: US scaffolding demand tied to AI-chip and semiconductor fab capex — long-term projects, not one-offs — with plants at ~95% utilisation and capacity addable in three months.
Defence vertical live: DRDO-approved JT coolers won a ~₹20 cr Israel order plus ₹10 cr missile canisters, repeat orders flowing.

KALYANKJIL.name: Kalyan Jewellers India
lines: FY27 rollout of 84 Kalyan and 50 Candere showrooms, mostly FOCO, on a 524-store base — franchise model lifted ROCE to 30.3% from 11.7% in FY20.
International now 41 showrooms (38 Middle East, 2 US, 1 UK) at ~14% of revenue.

PAISALO.name: Paisalo Digital
lines: Promoters lifted stake to 46.72% from 41.75% via open-market buys (Jul 1 upper circuit), backing a three-year roadmap to double AUM from ₹6,001 cr.
₹2,949 cr public NCD allotment funds the SBI co-lending book for SME loans; Dubai investor meetings Sep 17–19.

UFLEX.name: UFLEX
lines: Over ₹750 cr invested in new Mexico and Noida units for woven polypropylene bags and recycling; Mexico plant (80 mn bags/yr) began production Aug 1, 2026.
Aseptic packaging capacity ramping to 24 bn packs/yr by FY27 (Sanand now 12 bn); FY27 revenue and EBITDA growth guided at 35%.

PTCIL.name: PTC Industries
lines: Airbus titanium-casting agreement (A320neo, A330neo, A350) plus Safran LEAP engine castings and a new BrahMos missile sub-system order extend aerospace and strategic pipeline.
₹1,800 crore QIP launched Oct 7, floor ₹22,150, funding Lucknow forging, titanium and superalloy melting capacity.

NILKAMAL.name: Nilkamal Limited
lines: No public catalyst — the run since August is momentum and re-rating off a low base; NSE sought a volume clarification on Aug 20, and no order, capex or deal announcement sits behind the move.

KMEW.name: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works
lines: ₹279.33 cr, 15-year green tug contract from Mumbai Port Authority - third green tug order after Visakhapatnam's ₹384.33 cr; order book above ₹1,300 cr.
Board approved NCDs up to ₹500 cr to fund fleet build-out; ₹127.12 cr IWAI dredger order (18-month execution) already in book.

SAILIFE.name: Sai Life Sciences Limited
lines: FY27 capex of ₹1,100–1,300 cr, 65% CDMO — Bidar heads to ~1,150 KL with two 225 KL blocks commissioning Q2 and Q4 FY27 plus 200 KL by Q3.
Over 90% of FY27 revenue target already covered by orders in hand — the Sep 2 disclosure that took the stock to a record ₹1,578.

RISHABH.name: Rishabh Instruments Limited
lines: Domestic order bookings up ~20% YoY on current transformers, data centres and energy metering, with Nashik's built-up area doubled to lift CT and panel-meter capacity; FY27 guided at 20–25% growth.
Lumel SA's €3 mn (~₹30 cr) repeat order from a German energy major, Apr 16, runs through end-2027.

QUADFUTURE.name: Quadrant Future Tek
lines: Order book ₹898 cr including ₹613 cr of onboard Kavach 4.0 for FY27 delivery — CLW's ₹287.82 cr for 353 locos and ICF's ₹230.42 cr for 192.
RDSO cleared Kavach 4.0 for passenger trials in May 2026, the final stage before commercial rollout across Indian Railways' 44,000 km programme.

UNIPARTS.name: Uniparts India
lines: New business wins of ₹225 cr-plus over the trailing 12 months across 3-point linkage, precision machined parts and fabrications, securing revenue for the next 12–24 months.
Dual-shore India–US manufacturing with new Mexico warehousing is winning share as tariffs bite; global tractor and off-highway end markets recovering after a prolonged downcycle.

PVP.name: PVP Ventures
lines: Pivot from Chennai real estate into healthcare — ₹127 cr for 7Med/Epitome (22 dialysis facilities, four kidney hospitals), plus ₹55 cr for Optimus Oncology, both heading to 76% ownership.
Second 7Med tranche closed Jul 7, 2026, taking the stake to 41.23% with majority 50.62% contracted within 12 months.

AVALON.name: Avalon Technologies
lines: Semiconductor equipment entry — commercial production of power boxes for a global wafer-fab equipment supplier, a standalone vertical within 18–24 months on new Chennai land, positioned for ISM 2.0.
Order book ₹2,208 cr at Jun 30, up 23.4%, with FY27 growth guidance raised to 26–30%; BESS grew 52%.

IPCALAB.name: IPCA Laboratories
lines: ₹700–800 cr capex cycle — greenfield Wardha API plant began commercial production Feb 2026, with new capacity at Dewas, Silvassa and Ratlam; FY27 growth guidance raised to 14–16%.
US business guided to grow 15–17% with 7–8 launches annually alongside Unichem; German subsidiary Ipca Pharmaceuticals GmbH opens EU generics distribution.

JINDWORLD.name: Jindal Worldwide
lines: ₹650 cr rights issue approved Aug 7, 2026 to make the textile major debt-free by FY27.
EV arm Jindal Mobilitric began R40 e-scooter dispatches in July on 2.5 lakh-unit Ahmedabad capacity, targeting ₹100 cr FY27 / ₹350 cr FY28 revenue and 100 showrooms by FY28.

KENNAMET.name: Kennametal India Limited
lines: Board-approved ₹68 cr greenfield MSG (machining solutions) plant to add capacity and localise for aerospace, automotive, electronics and energy demand.
No dated public trigger for the Aug 21–Sep 10 run from ₹4,016 to ₹5,110; the only event was a Sep 7 institutional investor meet.

IRISDOREME.name: Iris Clothings
lines: Acquiring 51% of Infinia Lifestyle for ₹57.12 cr via 77.08 lakh shares at ₹41.67; production capacity being raised to 38,000 pieces/day, funded by ₹47.5 cr rights issue.
Doreme brand listed on Amazon; distributor network at 194 after eight additions in a quarter.

CRAFTSMAN.name: Craftsman Automation
lines: FY27 capex plan about ₹1,500 cr (standalone above ₹1,000 cr, DR Axion ₹430 cr) across aluminium and powertrain; Ludhiana plant commercial production began Jun 29, 2026.
Kothavadi large-engine plant has $50m of $100m order target received; ₹150 cr EV powertrain order; German machining unit set up Aug 27.

AEGISLOG.name: Aegis Logistics Limited
lines: Advanced talks to acquire UAE's Tristar for ~$1.5 bn — West Asia's largest private liquid-logistics firm, 30-plus countries, clients ADNOC, Total and Dow — under an exclusivity period.
Aegis Vopak's $5 bn capex pipeline to 2030: ₹525 cr Pipavav ammonia terminal (effective Aug 24) and a ₹142.5 cr 51,998 MT JNPA propane tank.

REDINGTON.name: Redington Limited
lines: Authorised Apple distributor across India, Middle East and Africa — Sep 9 launch of the iPhone 18 Pro series and the first foldable iPhone Duo drove a 6–7% jump to a record ₹398.80 on Sep 10.
Ambit NDR in London Sep 9; ahead of the festive-season iPhone 18 sales cycle.

MANALIPETC.name: Manali Petrochemicals
lines: No company-specific catalyst found for the early-October spike to a ₹92.99 high; only technical momentum and volume surge reported, with no filing or announcement behind it.

GRANULES.name: Granules India Limited
lines: Promoter warrants converted Sep 16 — 2.5 cr shares at ₹585, ₹1,461.5 cr of fresh equity to fund the Senn Chemicals peptide CDMO build-out and Genome Valley capacity.
Funded by a Sep 11 ₹1,500 cr block sale to Capital Group, ChrysCapital and Kotak Life; promoter stake now 31.08%.

CAPLIPOINT.name: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited
lines: US injectables scale-up — 10 approved ANDAs acquired Jan 2026 ($473 mn market), ₹1,000 cr capex with Gummidipoondi injectables/ophthalmics plant due Q4FY27.
Steady ANDA flow: Calcium Gluconate (May 5), Potassium Phosphates, Desmopressin, Sodium Phosphates ($67 mn) — 53 of 54 filings approved.

RACLGEAR.name: RACL Geartech Limited
lines: Global nominations stacking — ZF electric power steering components for North American trucks (SOP FY28), BMW EV drivetrain gears and parking locks into mass production late 2026, 15 new Kawasaki parts, Royal Enfield engine gears.
₹77.45 cr FY27 capex at Gajraula (₹33.88 cr electric heat-treatment, ₹30.04 cr capacity); FY27 revenue target ₹565 cr.

INDNIPPON.name: India Nippon Electricals Limited
lines: No public catalyst — the 20% upper circuit at ₹1,346.70 on Sep 9 drew an exchange volume query on Sep 10; the only dated event was a Sep 3 ICICI Securities institutional investor meet.

INDIAGLYCO.name: India Glycols
lines: Demerger into three entities effective Sep 1, 2026 (NCLT-approved Jul 17): IGL Spirits at 1:1 and Ennature Bio Pharma at 1:3.
Oct 13 spike on speculation over listing dates of the two demerged companies; board also to consider an equity fundraise.

GOCLCORP.name: GOCL Corporation Limited
lines: Kukatpally land monetisation — ₹3,402 cr for 264.5 acres with Squarespace Builders; 142 acres already sold, balance sale timeline extended to August 2026.
Post the ₹107 cr IDL Explosives sale to Apollo Defence, GOCL is pivoting to an energy-focused company.

KSL.name: Kalyani Steels
lines: Odisha cabinet cleared (Feb 2, 2026) the Kalyani Group's ₹17,250 cr Dhenkanal complex — Kalyani Steels builds a 700,000 TPA advanced specialty steel unit plus a 10,000 TPA titanium alloy plant for aerospace and defence.
45% capital investment subsidy on plant and machinery; units targeted operational within two years.

MAHSEAMLES.name: Maharashtra Seamless
lines: Order book ₹1,709 cr at Jul 31, 2026, up 31% QoQ — ₹714 cr of ONGC and Oil India seamless-pipe orders, 20% exports, plus a ₹100 cr cylinder-pipe order.
Jindal Explorer rig on a three-year ONGC charter; FY27 dispatch guidance 4.1–4.3 lakh tonnes.

AEGISVOPAK.name: Aegis Vopak Terminals
lines: Acquired a 36,000 MT ammonia storage terminal at Pipavav for ₹525 cr, effective Aug 24, 2026 — first ammonia asset, targeting fertiliser and energy-transition demand.
Capex ramp to $1.2 bn by FY27-end and $5 bn by 2030, expanding from seven ports to twelve.

NRBBEARING.name: NRB Bearings
lines: Aerospace pivot — Mahant Tool Room acquisition closed Jul 17, 2026, bringing AS9100D certification for aero-engine and fuel-system components, under a ₹500 cr five-year capex into industrial and aerospace.
₹200 cr European expansion backs ₹600 cr lifetime-nominated BMW, Stellantis and Renault programmes; order book ₹1,450 cr, 40% EV.

NEOGEN.name: Neogen Chemicals
lines: Li-ion battery materials build-out: ₹1,795 cr capex (₹1,298 cr spent), Dahej Phase 1 due Feb 2027, Pakhajan Phase 2 due Mar 2027.
₹600 cr QIP at ₹2,255 (6.5x subscribed, September 2026) funds battery projects and debt cut; electrolyte unit merger into NML for ₹245 cr.

SANSERA.name: Sansera Engineering
lines: ADS order book swelled to ₹5,700 cr (executable by FY31) after a ₹1,250 cr five-year semiconductor-equipment order worth ~$75 mn a year; FY27 ADS revenue guided ₹550–600 cr.
An 80,000 sq ft aerospace hangar and a 100,000 sq ft build-to-suit facility start contributing from Q3 FY27.

GRAPHITE.name: Graphite India Limited
lines: GrafTech's Sep 9 minimum 30% graphite electrode price hike — its second in 2026 after a 51 kt capacity cut — reset global realisations after years of weak pricing.
With HEG's electrode business hived off, Graphite India is the only listed pure-play; stock hit a record ₹874 on the news.

ICIL.name: Indo Count
lines: US tariff on Indian home textiles easing from the 50% peak after the early-2026 India-US trade deal, normalising export economics for bedding.
US utility bedding and branded push targets $275 mn revenue by FY28; FY27 guidance of ~₹4,000 cr core revenue and 105-110 mn metres volume.

SYNCOMF.name: Syncom Formulations (India) Limited
lines: No public catalyst found — the move coincides only with a founder-to-son management transition (Aug 11) and quarterly results; no order, approval or expansion announced.

KINGFA.name: Kingfa Science & Technology India
lines: No identifiable catalyst: rally to record highs reads as momentum, with no order, capacity or approval announcement found.

VISHNU.name: Vishnu Chemicals Limited
lines: Sep 8 50:50 JV with France's DCX Chrome for a 6,000 MTPA greenfield high-purity chromium metal plant at Visakhapatnam — aerospace, defence and energy grades, using DCX aluminothermic technology.
Vishnu supplies chrome oxide green feedstock; site sits beside its chromium complex and Vizag port for exports.

BLUSPRING.name: Bluspring Enterprises
lines: Acquired STEAG India for ₹180 crore (21 May 2026); it won O&M contracts of ₹2,049.8 crore (BALCO, 1,740 MW) and ₹1,437 crore (Vedanta, 1,215 MW).
Order book about ₹5,100 crore; energy services subsidiary merger on 12 Aug 2026.

IKIO.name: IKIO Technologies
lines: Diversification beyond LED lighting into EMS — hearables, wearables, automotive lighting, electronic components — with Block II (2 lakh sq ft) at Noida partially commercialised in Q2FY27 and Block III (1 lakh sq ft) under construction.
Sep 10–11 investor meets and Noida plant visit showcased the new capacity to analysts.

EIMCOELECO.name: Eimco Elecon India
lines: Open order pipeline tripled to ₹133 crore at Sep 30, 2026 versus ₹44 crore a year earlier, on mining equipment demand.
Battery-operated mine vehicle (Mine Car-E) launched April 2026; local component sourcing above 85%.

PITTIENG.name: Pitti Engineering
lines: ₹290 cr greenfield casting plant in Hyderabad targeting 36,000 MT by Q1FY30, lifting machining capacity 7.2 lakh → 10.8 lakh hours; sheet-metal capacity going 90,000 → 1,08,000 MT by FY27.
NCLT on Sep 8 approved merging Pitti Industries and Dakshin Foundry into the parent, effective Apr 1, 2026.

SHAREINDIA.name: Share India Securities
lines: Board meets Sep 18 to approve a preferential issue of equity, warrants or convertibles to fund strategic growth — quantum and terms due after the meeting.
Sep 17 completed the 100% acquisition of Enshrine Leasing for ₹39.72 cr, securing a Mumbai IT-zone property.

INNOVACAP.name: Innova Captab
lines: Capacity build-out at 85–90% utilisation: ₹45 cr Baddi brownfield expansion (Aug 21) adds two oral-solid lines plus an ointment line over 18–22 months, on top of the ₹459 cr Kathua greenfield plant.
Sep 3 board gave in-principle nod to a ₹50 cr land purchase for the next phase.

PCJEWELLER.name: PC Jeweller
lines: Repaid all 14 consortium banks ahead of schedule, turning debt-free (Oct 7-21), after a fundraise of up to ₹500 cr via preferential equity and warrants (Sep 24).
Plans up to 100 new showrooms over 12-18 months.

DCBBANK.name: DCB Bank Limited
lines: RBI on Sep 8 cleared ICICI Prudential AMC to take its stake up to 9.95% of paid-up capital, with a one-year window to acquire — a large, sustained institutional bid for a ₹7,200 cr bank.
Stock hit a record ₹234.50 the same day; branch network at 480 as of Jun 30.

MWL.name: Mangalam Worldwide Limited
lines: Empanelled as an approved vendor to ADNOC (Sep 7) for MWL-Tubicore seamless tubes, stacking on Qatar Energy, BHEL, EIL and GSFC approvals — global oil & gas access for a fully integrated stainless mill.
July export turnover hit a record ₹21.79 cr, ~4x YoY; stock at an all-time high ₹45 on Sep 15.

INDOBORAX.name: Indo Borax & Chemicals
lines: Agreed to buy 64.26% of Kronox Lab Sciences for ₹246 cr (Aug 20, 2026), plus open offer for 25.79% with Zenrock.
Zenrock took control (58.41%) after Apr 2026 open offer; ₹50 cr boric acid and boron oxide capex planned.

UGARSUGAR.name: The Ugar Sugar Works Limited
lines: Karnataka High Court on Sep 11 set aside the KSPCB closure order on the Ugar Khurd plant, keeping the 845 KLPD ethanol distillery (₹200 cr expansion, from 75 KLPD) running into the crushing season.
Stock recovered as the Sep 16 filing confirmed operations fully intact.

SUNDRMFAST.name: Sundram Fasteners Limited
lines: EV sub-assembly order book lifted from $250 mn to $425 mn (~₹4,000 cr over 5–6 years) on US OEM wins; capacity being added at Sri City and Mahindra World City on ₹350–400 cr capex.
Export growth guided 15–20% for FY27 as US Class 8 truck demand recovers; stock up ~25% in September.

WELENT.name: Welspun Enterprises Limited
lines: Order book at ₹18,729 cr (55% water) after the ₹7,300 cr Pune–Shirur NH-753F highway, a 29-year DBFOT toll sub-concession signed Jul 13.
Asset recycling: ₹1,000 cr sale of the Aunta-Simaria Ganga bridge SPV to BIIF closes by Sep 30, with ₹1,000 cr private placement enabled at the Aug 20 AGM.

SOLARINDS.name: Solar Industries India
lines: Order book ₹21,350 cr, over ₹18,000 cr defence — FY27 defence revenue guidance raised ₹3,000 cr → ₹4,500 cr, backed by ₹2,050 cr capex for missile and munitions capacity.
Army Project Sanction Order for Bhargavastra counter-drone system in June 2026; ₹1,076 cr three-year defence export contract signed May 29.

LOTUSDEV.name: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty
lines: Four Mumbai launches due in FY27 — Bandra, Prabhadevi, Versova, Andheri West — with ₹3,500–4,000 cr GDV, plus a ₹1,600 cr Juhu commercial redevelopment added to the pipeline.
Capital Group's Smallcap World Fund bought 1.95% for ₹190 cr at ₹199 on Sep 10; stock hit a 52-week high of ₹215.

TNPETRO.name: Tamilnadu PetroProducts
lines: LAB capacity expanded 120,000 → 145,000 MTPA at ₹365 cr, commissioned Mar 11, 2026; Propylene Oxide plant back on stream from May 6.
₹207 cr bipolar-membrane caustic soda cell house (250 TPD) and a ₹30 cr propylene recovery unit are the next legs of the Manali expansion.

OMAXE.name: Omaxe
lines: No public catalyst found — the early-September run to 52-week highs came on volume and momentum; the last hard drivers were the ₹2,700 cr UPSRTC bus-terminal PPP (Mar 2025) and ₹500 cr Omaxe Chowk Ludhiana (Jan 2026).

EBGNG.name: GNG Electronics
lines: Refurbished laptop capacity built to 150,000 units/month versus ~60,000 current volume, with distribution pacts via Ingram Micro, Supertron (Feb 2026) widening reach.
Pan-India distribution tie-up with Redington (1 Jul 2026) sent shares to a record; momentum extended to all-time highs through Sept-Oct.

KSHINTL.name: KSH International
lines: Only Indian winding wire approved for 400 kV HVDC transformers; capacity 43,445 MT → ~59,000 MT by March 2027 via ₹150–160 cr Supa Phase II.
Five-year supply framework with Hitachi Energy covering its Indian and global plants; 765 kV/HVDC orders now over 25% of CTC volume.

RAMRAT.name: Ram Ratna Wires
lines: ₹86 cr Silvassa capex adds 3,600 MT of winding-wire capacity by March 2027 on a ~45,500 MT base running at 80% utilisation, within a ₹700 cr three-year plan.
The 24,000 MTPA Bhiwadi copper-tube plant is scaling on HVAC demand, lifting copper tubes to 27% of revenue.

KROSS.name: Kross Ltd
lines: Axle beam extrusion capacity raised 60% to 8,000 units/month, commercial production from July 2026; axle volumes up 34% YoY in Q1 FY27.
Seamless tube facility due by Q4 FY27; axle shaft robotic-forging unit and foundry moulding line due by Sep 2026.

TDPOWERSYS.name: TD Power Systems
lines: AI data-centre and grid demand took Q1FY27 order inflow to ₹734 cr, up 87% YoY with 93% exports; order book ₹2,207 cr, FY27 revenue guidance raised to ₹2,600 cr.
Sep 10 EGM cleared a ₹600 cr QIP plus ₹75 cr preferential; exchange nod came Sep 11, stock hit ₹818.85 on Sep 15.

ALIVUS.name: Alivus Life Sciences
lines: Solapur Phase I goes live early Q3FY27 under a ₹540 cr FY27 capex, fully internally funded, adding complex-API and CDMO capacity across Solapur, Ankleshwar and Dahej.
Jul 9 crofelemer supply deal with Jaguar Health's Napo runs to Mar 31, 2029 with minimum purchase commitments; two more CDMO contracts due early H2FY27.

STAR.name: Strides Pharma Science
lines: USFDA closed the May 12–20 inspection of the flagship Bengaluru plant with a VAI-classified EIR on Aug 20, clearing the US pipeline; stock jumped 11% to ₹1,055.90.
$12 mn Sandoz branded-generics portfolio across Sub-Saharan Africa adds to ex-US growth from H2FY27.

MANORAMA.name: Manorama Industries
lines: ₹460 cr capex adds 75,000 MTPA cocoa-butter-alternative capacity, 75,000 MTPA fractionation, a 90,000 MTPA refinery and a 90,000 MTPA Burkina Faso shea-processing plant, commissioning around Q3FY28.
₹500 cr ADIA-backed QIP closed July 2026; board approved ₹75 cr infusion into six overseas subsidiaries on Sep 4.

SEAMECLTD.name: Seamec Limited
lines: Two ONGC vessel O&M wins in March 2026 — ₹410.74 cr for Samudra Sevak (738 days) and ₹329.92 cr for Samudra Prabha (698 days) — lock revenue through 2028.
A $5.21 mn Seamec Glorious charter for ONGC hook-up work starts Oct 15–31, 2026; roadshow held Sep 10.

NAZARA.name: Nazara Technologies
lines: ₹733.5 cr preferential issue at ₹306/share (Aug 6) funds acquisitions, IP and AI game development; incoming CEO Stauffer invests ₹583.5 cr.
Stake in Funky Monkeys Play Centre raised to 64% (Aug 22); no specific trigger found for the Oct 12 rally.

CONFIPET.name: Confidence Petroleum India Limited
lines: CNG and auto-LPG build-out: 50 GAIL Gas stations live in Bengaluru heading to 100, auto-LPG stations 310 → 500, plus a Type 4 high-pressure cylinder plant in Nagpur.
The ₹250.11 cr preferential issue is fully deployed into capex; ₹50 cr earmarked for six LPG bottling plants in Indonesia.

TMB.name: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Limited
lines: FY27 guidance raised at the Q1 call: advances growth to 21–22%, deposits to 18%, ROA "well over 2%", NIM past 4%, GNPA held under 1%.
60 new branches planned for FY27 (vs 44 last year) alongside RBI agency-bank status for government business.

CENTUM.name: Centum Electronics Limited
lines: ECMS approval on Aug 17 for a ₹106 cr, five-year investment in transducers and filters — import-substitution components — on top of a ₹1,800 cr order book, up 31%.
A $3.22 mn export order from a global OEM landed Sep 1, with SEMICON India (Sep 17–19) lifting the pack.

ANANDRATHI.name: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited
lines: IFSCA registration effective Sep 11 makes Anand Rathi FME (IFSC) a licensed fund manager at GIFT City, seeded with ₹5.49 cr; London and Bahrain offices in the works.
FY27 targets: AUM ₹1.2 lakh cr from ₹1.06 lakh cr, revenue ₹1,415 cr.

HAPPYFORGE.name: Happy Forgings
lines: ₹650 cr heavyweight-forging capex (10,000-tonne press) commissioning in FY27, lifting forging capacity to ~180,000 MT by FY28; ₹950 cr incremental order book, 42–45% industrials.
New European industrial order for >1,000 kg components — ₹160 cr peak annual revenue — plus ₹140 cr fresh PV/industrial wins in Q1FY27.

HINDOILEXP.name: Hindustan Oil Exploration
lines: Production ramp target of 32,000 BOEPD by 2029 — 100%-owned B-80 gets three new wells on $30.5 mn FY27 capex; Dirok FDP extended to 2035, pipeline doubling to 2.5 mmscmd by Dec 2026.
Aug 13: B-80 MOPU compressors reconfigured, partial gas sales resumed; crude now sold to third parties.

MOLDTECH.name: Mold-Tek Technologies
lines: US data-centre, grid and T&D build-out driving structural/mechanical engineering demand via Florida subsidiary Beryl Project Engineering (acquired Oct 31, 2025); a second US structural-engineering acquisition under evaluation.
Beryl won a $1 mn county master purchase order in Florida and is expanding into additional US states.

YASHO.name: Yasho Industries
lines: 15-year lubricant-additives supply agreement with a global MNC worth ~₹150 cr a year from end-FY27, on the ₹470 cr, 20,000 MTPA Pakhajan (Dahej) plant ramping to 26,000 TPA by FY27.
₹23 cr Pakhajan R&D centre operational in 2026; management guiding 30–40% growth.

SENORES.name: Senores Pharmaceuticals
lines: US buildout: ₹91 cr Apnar Pharma acquisition with five ANDAs, 14 ANDAs bought from Dr Reddy's, 51% of Zoraya for front-end, and the 70%-owned Amerisyn JV (Apr 2, 2026) for US federal/VA supply.
USFDA inspection of Apnar's Vadodara plant closed Sep 11 with zero GMP observations.

VINDHYATEL.name: Vindhya Telelinks
lines: Board approved merger with Birla Cable (10 VTL shares per 115 Birla Cable, effective Apr 1, 2026), creating an integrated specialty cable platform.
Further ₹65 cr to expand speciality optical fibre cable capacity at Rewa (total outlay ₹101.7 cr) for AI/data-centre demand; ₹200 cr NCD raise authorised (May 2026).

SOTL.name: Savita Oil Technologies
lines: Mahad synthetic ester plant Phase 2 commissioned (Feb 28, 2026) after Phase 1 (5,000 tpa design), making Savita maker of mineral, natural and synthetic ester transformer fluids.

ROSSTECH.name: Rossell Techsys
lines: Order book ~₹800 cr (Jun 30, 2026) with ₹240 cr of purchase orders won in Q1 and repeat overseas defence wire-harness order (May 6, 2026).
₹30 cr lease of 2,10,000 sq ft adjoining facility (May 12), phased over 4-12 months.

WOCKPHARMA.name: Wockhardt
lines: Zaynich (cefepime-zidebactam) won US FDA approval May 30, 2026 — the first Indian-developed NCE cleared in the US — with $1.5 bn peak-sales potential and a self-run US launch targeted by end-CY26/Q1 2027.
EMA review under way across cUTI, cIAI, HAP/VAP and bloodstream infections; Europe approval guided for Dec 2026–Jan 2027.

JTLIND.name: JTL Industries
lines: Subsidiary JTL Engineering will double narrow-width HR coil capacity from 60,000 to 120,000 tonnes a year via ₹15 crore capex, boosting captive HRC supply.
Commissioning targeted Q4 FY27; announced Aug 24, 2026. Also won a ₹27 crore GI pipes order from HPSCSC.

MACPOWER.name: Macpower CNC Machines
lines: Capacity raised to 2,500 CNC machines a year after a 40,000 sq ft assembly facility (Nov 2025); greenfield plant planned for 10,000 machines, half reserved for defence.
Order book about ₹456 cr (Jun 30), NEXA 40%; ₹319 cr defence and aerospace bids pending; guides 25% quarterly order growth in FY27.

ARTEMISMED.name: Artemis Medicare Services
lines: ₹800 cr three-year capex to reach 2,000 beds by FY30, funded by a ₹700 cr QIP: 300-bed Raipur hospital opened Jul 9; 650-bed South Delhi VIMHANS campus (₹350–360 cr); 200+ bed Gurugram Tower 4 (₹120 cr).
Raipur OTs and cath labs live since Jul 28; 52-week high ₹361.5 on Sep 10.

BHAGERIA.name: Bhageria Industries
lines: H-acid capacity at Tarapur raised 400 to 500 MT/month (~₹50-55 cr annual revenue); plasticizers and ethoxylates commercial output began 8 Oct 2025.
No fresh dated order or approval found behind the October move; ~70% of output is exported.

PAUSHAKLTD.name: Paushak
lines: New ₹175 cr multi-purpose phosgene-derivatives plant at Halol, Gujarat, began commissioning Jan 21, 2026; licensed phosgene capacity 14,400 MT/yr, up from 4,800.
Ramp-up of the new plant is the volume driver; no dated fresh trigger found.

LOKESHMACH.name: Lokesh Machines
lines: Steady defence order flow: ₹58.21 cr Indian Army order for 7.62mm MMG mod kits (Jul 15, 2026).
Earlier 2026 orders: ₹22 cr machine-pistol components (Jan 5), ₹6.3 cr Assam Rifles (Feb 13), ₹9.5 cr SSB carbines (Mar 17).

VALIANTORG.name: Valiant Organics
lines: No identifiable catalyst: exchange sought clarification on a sharp March 2026 price spike and the company cited no price-sensitive information, attributing it to market forces.

ONEPOINT.name: One Point One Solutions
lines: Closed $33.37M Netcom BCC buy (Costa Rica/Colombia/Panama) on 5 Mar 2026; Q1 FY27 revenue base rose 129% YoY, FY27 topline seen nearly doubling.
Aug 2026: 3-year Vijayanand Travels CX mandate; ₹39.32 crore power-utility CoE mandate with agentic AI.

OAL.name: Oriental Aromatics
lines: No verifiable catalyst found; capex paused, no order, approval or duty news. Likely momentum or sector rotation.

SAMBHV.name: Sambhv Steel Tubes
lines: ₹100 crore preferential issue of 86.95 lakh warrants at ₹115 each (25% upfront, ₹24.99 crore) funds capacity expansion toward 2 million tonnes by 2030.
EGM held 10 Aug 2026; warrants allotted.

ONWARDTEC.name: Onward Technologies
lines: Raised FY27 outlook on 16 Oct 2026 to 15-18% revenue growth and 13.8-14.3% EBITDA margin.
Multi-year contract renewal worth ₹44.46 crore in the quarter; earlier ₹33 crore, three-year power management win.

UTTAMSUGAR.name: Uttam Sugar Mills
lines: Sector event: Centre released 1.4 mn tonnes of sugar quota on 14 Oct 2026 amid firm global raw sugar prices; stock-limit curbs on dealers run to 30 Nov.

CUPID.name: Cupid Ltd
lines: FY27 guidance raised on Sep 30 to ₹800+ cr revenue and ₹250+ cr net profit, with Q2 revenue seen above ₹200 cr.
Palava plant adds ~770M male and 75M female condoms of annual capacity; in-principle approval for South Africa manufacturing venture.

OPTIEMUS.name: Optiemus Infracom
lines: Sep 22 binding term sheet with Nothing Electronics: JV to sell CMF phones, Optiemus taking 51.1%, building India's first end-to-end smartphone R&D capability.
Earlier Nothing manufacturing JV plans ~$100M (₹887 cr) over three years.

PREMIERPOL.name: Premier Polyfilm
lines: No identifiable catalyst: no order, capacity or policy announcement found; the move looks like momentum buying in a micro-cap.

AVTNPL.name: AVT Natural Products
lines: No identifiable structural catalyst found; the move traces only to earnings, with no order, capacity or deal announcement.

JGCHEM.name: J.G.Chemicals
lines: New Dahej zinc chemicals plant: 40,000 TPA, ₹100 cr capex from internal accruals, 11.43 acres; commissioning targeted FY27, peak revenue potential ~₹900 cr.
Subsidiary BDJ Oxides bought 16.74 acres next to Naidupeta plant for ₹18.41 cr; non-rubber share targeted 15% to over 30% in 4-5 years.

TCPLPACK.name: TCPL Packaging
lines: No fresh dated catalyst found; only ongoing ~₹100 cr FY27 capex, mainly flexible packaging, and the Chennai carton plant (Mar 2025) adding under 10% capacity.

DHAMPURSUG.name: Dhampur Sugar Mills
lines: Domestic sugar prices up ~10% in a month to a record ₹4,750-4,800/quintal on 30-year-low opening stocks; DAM Capital raised FY27-28 realisation estimate to ₹47/kg from ₹43-44.
Additional sugar export quota approved in March 2026; govt stock limit of 1,000 quintals applies Oct 15-Nov 30.

SBC.name: SBC Exports
lines: Repeat garment export orders from Dubai buyers, including a ₹18 cr HUXXE order (Jun 2026), under a Dubai/Middle East push targeting 40-50% FY27 growth.
A USD 794,110 export order against a Sep 3 purchase order, with two-month execution.

PVRINOX.name: PVR INOX
lines: ₹300 cr tender-offer buyback of 20.69 lakh shares at ₹1,450 (approved 31 Aug; window 10-17 Sep) set a price anchor well above market.
Stronger film slate and footfalls pushed shares ~10% to a 52-week high on 7 Oct.

ABDL.name: Allied Blenders and Distillers
lines: India-UK FTA to halve bulk Scotch import tariff from 150% to 75%; board also approved up to 50% stake in Kion Blenders (up to ₹45 cr).
Hit record ₹766.25 on 15 Oct; no company announcement dated in October explains the move.

PGIL.name: Pearl Global Industries
lines: Investor Day (25 Sep) set FY30 targets: revenue ₹9,000-10,000 cr vs ₹5,025 cr in FY26, capacity 100.8 to 170-175 mn pieces.
₹675-725 cr capex through FY30, including knit/processing backward integration in Bangladesh.

GOODLUCK.name: Goodluck India
lines: Defence arm won a ₹255 cr order for 155mm shells (10-month delivery), with capacity scaling from 1.5 lakh to 4 lakh shells a year.
Oct 12 board in-principle approval to merge the defence and green-energy subsidiaries into the parent; terms pending.

DALMIASUG.name: Dalmia Bharat Sugar and Industries
lines: Tight sugar supply: 2025-26 closing stocks seen near 4 mn tonnes, lowest since 2017, with global raw sugar at an 18-month high.
Govt dealer stock limit of 1,000 quintals from Oct 15 to Nov 30, and possible curbs on ethanol diversion, fuelled the Oct 6 sugar-sector rally.

SMCGLOBAL.name: SMC Global Securities
lines: Oct 14 board approved a ₹106 cr preferential issue of 1 crore convertible warrants at ₹106 each, convertible within 18 months; EGM set for Nov 6.
Also raised secured NCDs (24-60 month tenors, ICRA A Stable) from Oct 5, adding growth capital.

KOPRAN.name: Kopran Ltd
lines: Merger of Kopran Laboratories into Kopran (100 shares per 45) cleared by 99.95% of shareholders on Jun 3, and the NCLT Mumbai hearing was set for Aug 5; final sanction pending.
Mahad API plant cleared its USFDA inspection with zero observations.

MVGJL.name: Manoj Vaibhav Gems N Jewellers
lines: No fresh dated catalyst found; last hard items are the March 2026 ₹200 cr Visakhapatnam franchise deal and April 2026 Chandanagar store, so recent move looks sentiment-driven.

BALRAMCHIN.name: Balrampur Chini Mills
lines: Sugar upcycle: India 2025-26 output 28.1 mt vs 28.7 mt consumption, opening 2026-27 with lower stocks; global raw sugar near two-year highs, StoneX sees 0.9 mt deficit.
Dealer stock limit of 1,000 quintals (Oct 15-Nov 30) and possible curbs on cane diversion to ethanol lifted sugar stocks Oct 6.

APOLLO.name: Apollo Micro Systems
lines: Defence order flow keeps stacking: ₹134 cr DRDO/Navy (Jul), ₹213.39 cr DRDO/PSU/private (Aug 5), ₹80.84 cr more (Aug 17); order book ₹1,704 cr.
FY27 guidance of 40-45% revenue growth reaffirmed, targeting ₹3,500-4,000 cr year-end order book.

TATVA.name: Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem
lines: Board approved ₹200 cr greenfield Dahej-III project in Bharuch, adding 344 KL reactor capacity, to be executed in 21 months.
Borrowing limit raised from ₹300 cr to ₹1,000 cr (needs shareholder approval) to fund the expansion.

DYNAMATECH.name: Dynamatic Technologies
lines: Hutchinson Memorandum of Agreement (Mar 3, 2026): multi-year metallic aerostructure contract from Hutchinson, plus composite work package, targeting Indian and global OEM aerospace programmes.
Dassault Falcon 6X deal widened to the full Section 5 rear fuselage (Dec 2025).

CYIENT.name: Cyient Ltd
lines: Definitive agreement (May 31) to acquire US-based TAO Digital Solutions, an AI-native data and product engineering firm; closing expected by Q2 FY27.
Cyient DLM order book hit record ₹2,598.9 cr, with ₹551.9 cr inflows and 1.5x book-to-bill; ₹720 cr buyback at ₹1,125 completed.

PNGSREVA.name: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery
lines: IPO proceeds fund 15 new company-owned stores over 24 months, a ₹287 cr capex, ~60% in Maharashtra.
Network now 38 stores after Pune (Jul 7) and Nashik (Sep 23) openings; e-commerce site launched Sep 16.

IBULLSLTD.name: Indiabulls Ltd
lines: ₹3,700 cr Dwarka Expressway, Gurugram development-management deal (10.84 acres, 21 lakh sq ft) lifts project GDV pipeline to ₹27,308 cr.
Project launch targeted mid-October 2026; RBI Core Investment Company registration received Oct 2-3.

DELTACORP.name: Delta Corp
lines: Supreme Court GST ruling: Delta says revenue basis since Oct 2023 (not gross bet value) could apply retrospectively to Jul 2017-Sep 2023, easing the ₹16,822 cr demand.
Stock jumped 19% on Oct 5 as gaming GST adjudication awaited, with Oct 14 deadline set; outcome unconfirmed.

AEQUS.name: Aequs Ltd
lines: Board approved ₹650 cr promoter warrant issue (2.81 cr warrants at ₹231.55, ₹325 cr upfront) to fund aerospace and consumer capacity, including Hosur.
Shareholder vote at EGM on Oct 22; promoter stake rises to 60.73% on full conversion.

TARSONS.name: Tarsons Products
lines: No fresh catalyst found; Panchla and Amta capex (₹550-650 crore) is still ramping, with no new order, approval or deal dated recently.

THELEELA.name: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts
lines: Fast room expansion: Coorg Forest Sanctuary acquired (about ₹560-571 crore), adding to 4,160+ keys across 15 hotels, with 9 more in the pipeline.
25% stake in 546-key Sofitel The Palm Dubai (Brookfield holds 75%), reopening as The Leela in 2028.

LLOYDSENGG.name: Lloyds Engineering Works
lines: SISCOL acquisition via share swap, with 7.07 crore shares allotted at ₹71.25 (about ₹504 crore); consolidated order book cited at ₹8,857 crore.
Defence arm signed tech-transfer deal with Italy's Alpar Ingegneria; SAIL-IISCO pellet plant order of ₹613 crore plus €18 million.

MUKANDLTD.name: Mukand Ltd
lines: No company-specific catalyst found; stock hit 52-week highs (about ₹180-190) in late Sep-early Oct with no dated order, approval or deal behind it.

SHYAMMETL.name: Shyam Metalics and Energy
lines: Non-binding MoU (Oct 5) with Maharashtra for a ₹50,000 cr, 9 MTPA integrated steel complex at Chandrapur: Phase I 3.75 MTPA, Phase II 5.25 MTPA, ~30,000 jobs.
Aluminium foil plant in Odisha began commercial production; ₹4,500 cr fundraise plan announced in July funds expansion.

CPPLUS.name: Aditya Infotech
lines: Capacity doubling from 25 lakh units/month over two years, via Kadapa enclosure plant and Rajasthan cable facility, both due by Q3 FY27.
50:50 Corelink JV with Orient Cables (Apr 16) for LAN/CCTV cables cuts import dependence; Taiwan R&D subsidiary formed.

GALAXYSURF.name: Galaxy Surfactants
lines: Unilever Partnership Growth Charter (Aug 19) sets up co-invested, shared surfactant capacity in North America plus bio-based and lower-carbon chemistries.
DKSH exclusive distribution of specialty personal-care ingredients across 16 European markets; shift toward oleochemical-based surfactants.

KRISHANA.name: Krishana Phoschem
lines: Meghnagar (Madhya Pradesh) 500 TPD DAP/NPK and 300 TPD sulphuric acid plant began commercial production from March 31, 2026.
Ramp-up of the new capacity is the main volume driver; no fresh dated trigger found in October.

NYKAA.name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures
lines: Fashion scaling fast: Q2 FY27 business update (Oct 4-5) flags fashion NSV growth in late forties, beauty late twenties, GMV near 30%.
Offline expansion: 14 net new stores added in the quarter, taking the network to 338 stores by Sep 30.

ADVANCE.name: Advance Agrolife
lines: No identifiable company-specific catalyst found for the Oct 12-16 spike; coverage shows only technical breakout and upper-circuit buying.

SPORTKING.name: Sportking India
lines: ₹1,000 cr Odisha greenfield project adding 1.5 lakh spindles (~40% of base), commissioning targeted Q3 FY27.
Cotton yarn spreads widened to ₹114/kg in May from ₹74/kg in Oct-25, with import duty on cotton temporarily removed.

CARTRADE.name: Cartrade Tech
lines: CarTrade Used Auto platform (June) unifies CarWale and OLX India, targeting 2M units yearly and ₹1.2 lakh cr GMV.
Spinny partnership (Jul 29) on used-car buying and selling.

SANATHAN.name: Sanathan Textiles
lines: Silvassa technical-textiles yarn capacity doubled from 9,000 to 18,000 MTPA, commercial production started with German Rieter Barmag lines, serving defence, automotive, infrastructure and ballistic-protection uses.
Total installed capacity now 488,250 MTPA; start-up confirmed around Aug 21, 2026, on the July 23 timeline.

JAYKAY.name: Jaykay Enterprises
lines: Subsidiary Allen Reinforced Plastics won a ₹60.01 cr BrahMos Aerospace composite-parts order (Aug 25, 2026), following an earlier ₹94.45 cr BrahMos contract.
₹25 cr rights-issue infusion into JK Defence & Aerospace on Oct 5 took ownership to 100%; ₹154.29 cr rights raise funds subsidiary expansion.

AXISCADES.name: AXISCADES Technologies
lines: Bought 90% of Cloud Wave Technologies (₹234 cr cash, ₹260 cr EV), an AS9100D aerospace manufacturer with seven units and ~₹180 cr FY27 revenue; funded by ₹200 cr NCDs.
Akkodis AXISCADES Aerospace Engineering incorporated Sep 22 for planned 51% sale to Akkodis; block deal Sep 29 drove upper circuit.

BBOX.name: Black Box Ltd
lines: Won a $131 mn (~₹1,240 cr) US hyperscaler data-centre order, delivered over about three years, with further expansion expected (Aug 13, 2026).
FY26 order bookings crossed $1 bn; backlog $792 mn by March 2026; ₹2,500 cr expansion plan.

MEESHO.name: Meesho Ltd
lines: Festive Mega Blockbuster Sale 2026 day-one orders rose 75% YoY (Oct 12), with transacting customers up 60% and Meesho Mall orders up over 200%.
Transacting sellers grew about 63%, extending the festive-season demand momentum.

TIPSMUSIC.name: Tips Music
lines: No fresh hard catalyst identified; no new licensing deal, acquisition or catalogue announcement found for recent weeks.

SEJALLTD.name: Sejal Glass
lines: UAE subsidiary order book expanded from about AED 50 mn to AED 72 mn, with project execution starting June-July 2026.
New UAE tempering line from Q1 FY27 is projected to add AED 20-30 mn of business.

KARURVYSYA.name: Karur Vysya Bank
lines: Network expansion: 16 branches opened Aug 31, 2026 took total to 919; about 50 additions planned in FY27.
Targeting roughly 18% advances growth, funded by internal accruals with CRAR at 18.76%; repo-linked lending rate raised 25 bps to 8.80% from Oct 8.

MOTILALOFS.name: Motilal Oswal Financial Services
lines: No verifiable fresh catalyst found; recent strength looks like broader momentum in capital-market names, with no dated order, deal or approval identified.

EDELWEISS.name: Edelweiss Financial Services
lines: EAAA India Alternatives IPO cleared by SEBI on Apr 23, 2026: ₹1,500 cr pure offer-for-sale, unlocking value in the group's alternatives arm.
Edelweiss sold a 4.4% EAAA stake for ₹375 cr (Mar 2026) ahead of listing; ₹350 cr NCD public issue ran Sep 21-Oct 5.

63MOONS.name: 63 moons technologies
lines: NSEL settlement scheme approved by NCLT (Nov 2025): ₹1,950 cr payable to 5,682 traders, closing legal cases against the group.
Mumbai MPID court cancelled asset attachment on Jul 31, 2026, clearing the way for final one-time settlement.

RAIN.name: Rain Industries
lines: No hard dated catalyst verified; recent strength reflects higher calcination and distillation realisations, with no order, capex or deal confirmed.

SHRIPISTON.name: Shriram Pistons & Rings
lines: Acquired Grupo Antolin India entities (lighting, interiors, Chakan) for ₹1,670 cr (€159 mn), completed Jan 2026, diversifying beyond pistons.
Capacity expansion continues (Pithampur doubling, Coimbatore EV plant); ₹28 cr Sunbeam asset buy completed Jun 30, 2026.

NPST.name: Network People Services Technologies
lines: Bank-in-a-Box UPI switch SaaS platform winning cooperative banks: first mandate Mar 16, 2026, then three more co-op bank orders (May 14); order book grew ~40% in Q1 FY27.
UPI TPAP app SaaS contract from a Maharatna PSU disclosed Jun 22, 2026, adding recurring revenue.

BEPL.name: Bhansali Engineering Polymers
lines: ABS capacity debottlenecking at Abu Road and Satnoor plants lifts installed capacity from 75,000 to 100,000 TPA, targeted for commissioning by September 2026.
Roughly ₹200 crore project funded entirely from internal accruals, keeping the company debt-free.

GHCLTEXTIL.name: GHCL Textiles
lines: No fresh dated catalyst found; the ₹535 crore Tamil Nadu capacity-expansion MoU dates from January 2024, with no new 2026 order, approval or deal located.

DHANBANK.name: Dhanlaxmi Bank
lines: No fresh catalyst found; no order, approval, fundraise or deal news for Oct 2026, so the move looks like sector flow or trading activity.

SOUTHBANK.name: South Indian Bank
lines: RBI-approved new MD & CEO Mahesh Pai took charge Oct 1, 2026 for a three-year term; shareholders backed him with 99.13% votes at the Aug 20 AGM.
The AGM also cleared a Tier-II bond fundraise; the Q2 business update on Oct 5 added momentum.

ALICON.name: Alicon Castalloy
lines: Board approved ₹125.5 cr capex for a new Shikrapur (Pune) plant: 1.3 lakh sq ft on a 10-year lease, gravity die casting, LPDC and machining.
Order book about ₹7,600 cr executable over six years; plan announced Aug 13 with Q1 FY27 numbers; FY27 capex about ₹140 cr.

ARIHANTCAP.name: Arihant Capital Markets
lines: No real catalyst found; no order, fundraise or deal news in Sep-Oct 2026, with only CFO appointment and IEPF filings, so the move looks like routine trading.

ARFIN.name: Arfin India
lines: ₹300 cr letter of intent (Jun 19) from JFE Shoji India for 7,400 MT of aluminium deox products, executable till Sep 2026; repeat of a ~₹180 cr, 6,900 MT order from Sep 2025.
Subsidiary signed a 1-year global supply collaboration with Japan's JFE Shoji and Toyo Denka, building export-linked volumes.

GESHIP.name: Great Eastern Shipping
lines: Fleet renewal: contracted secondhand 2019-built Kamsarmax bulker (~81,600 dwt, 8 Sep 2026), another ~81,900 dwt on 7 Aug; Q3 FY27 delivery, internal accruals.
Old tonnage sold: 2007-built Jag Prakash and 2003-built Jag Pankhi tankers (Apr 2026); fleet 40 vessels.

COFORGE.name: Coforge Ltd
lines: Encora acquisition ($2.35 bn EV, share swap plus $550 mn debt) closed 23 Apr 2026, adding $100.7 mn quarterly revenue (~17% of total).
Executable order book record $2.23 bn (+44% YoY); expanded Pegasystems partnership on 28 Aug 2026.

FINEORG.name: Fine Organic Industries
lines: JNPA SEZ facility expected to contribute from H2 FY28, with a planned US plant adding from FY29, driving long-term capacity growth.
Patalganga food-grade plant guided to reach full utilisation by FY27.

GAEL.name: Gujarat Ambuja Exports
lines: Maize-processing expansion: maltodextrin capacity lifted from 7,000 to 23,000 MTPA from 28 March 2026, under a roughly ₹1,400 cr capex plan through FY28.
Environmental clearance for a 180 KLPD grain-based ethanol and extra-neutral alcohol plant at Malda, West Bengal (about ₹180 cr).

TI.name: Tilaknagar Industries
lines: Imperial Blue acquisition from Pernod Ricard India closed 1 December 2025 for ₹3,442 cr plus deferred payment; it added 4.6 mn cases in Q4 FY26.
Prag Distillery expansion (6 to 36 lakh cases) cleared to start in May 2026; FY27 guidance is high-single to low-double-digit volume growth.

MANOMAY.name: Manomay Tex India
lines: Board approved capacity expansion on 31 August 2026: denim capacity rises about 10 mn metres a year (48 to 58 mn) through a new RFD line.
Spinning adds about 1,080 MT a year of coarse-count yarn capacity (17,640 to 18,720 MT).

LUMAXTECH.name: Lumax Auto Technologies
lines: Board approved a ₹156.23 cr Chakan plant on 10 August 2026 for the Intelligent Ambient Comfort division, serving new Mahindra & Mahindra orders; peak turnover is about ₹440 cr.
IAC India merger became effective 18 May 2026; the plant opens in two phases, Q4 FY27 and Q1 FY28.

STEELCAS.name: Steelcast Ltd
lines: Board approved a ₹120 cr greenfield foundry of 8,500 tonnes, fast-tracked on strong demand and new parts converting to serial supply for mining and heavy machinery clients.
2.4 MW hybrid power plant commissioned by June 30, 2026, targeting ₹3.5-4 cr annual power savings.

UDS.name: Updater Services
lines: No operating catalyst found; move tied to SIS Ltd raising its stake to 8.19% via 10.27 lakh shares (₹21.59 cr, Aug 19, 2026) after a deep drawdown.

BHEL.name: Bharat Heavy Electricals
lines: Thermal order wave: ₹13,500 cr NTPC Telangana Stage-II (2,400 MW) plus ₹21,000 cr MUNPL EPC order; FY26 inflows about ₹75,000 cr.
Thermal bid pipeline estimated near 30 GW (about ₹2.4 trn); Q2 FY27 inflow only ₹4,000 cr, so order lumpiness drives swings.

GABRIEL.name: Gabriel India
lines: Project Jupiter: acquiring 28.99% of HL Mando Anand India for ₹2,231 cr (₹350 cr cash, rest preferential shares); HL Klemove ADAS JV, 30% stake for $98.4m.
Faurecia Anand seating JV (close by end-2026); ₹180 cr FY27 capex; Jinhap fastener plant production targeted Q3 FY27.

VIDYAWIRES.name: Vidya Wires
lines: ALCU Industries Narsanda (Gujarat) unit adds 18,000 MT, lifting capacity from 19,680 to 37,680 MT; commercial production started Feb 2026.
Product range widens from 12 to 20, including solar cables, copper foils and enamelled aluminium strips, aimed at renewable and transformer demand.

TECHM.name: Tech Mahindra
lines: Five-year Orange Business partnership (global support, quote-to-bill) with Brazil's Alyis acquired Jul 2; separate 5-year Telefónica O2 contract above $500m ramping in H2 FY27.
Q1 FY27 deal wins $1.078bn, third straight quarter above $1bn; Avant Techno (Canada) acquired for payments modernisation.

SGMART.name: SG Mart
lines: Multi-year capex of over ₹1,500 cr from internal accruals to scale steel distribution toward a 2030 target of 4 mn tonnes volume and ₹1,000 cr EBITDA.
FY27 EBITDA guided at about ₹300 cr, with FY27 capex of roughly ₹400-500 cr; net cash about ₹690 cr funds the build-out.

ARIS.name: Arisinfra Solutions
lines: Contract manufacturing scale-up: 10+ partner plants with 9 mn tonnes/yr reserved capacity, with 20-25% more planned via new plant partnerships in FY27.
Developer-as-a-Service wins: ₹650 cr GDV Wadhwa Wise City, Panvel project and ₹79 cr Goregaon-Mulund Link Road tunnel order; 10 active DaaS projects.

CEIGALL.name: Ceigall India
lines: Order book of roughly ₹18,554 cr after a steady run of highway wins, including ₹2,160 cr NHAI HAM project (NH-139W, Bihar) in Feb 2026.
Aug 2026: five MoRTH awards worth ₹2,423.70 cr on NH-913 Arunachal, plus ₹225 cr Una bulk drug park contract; ₹918 cr Jaipur Metro JV earlier.

JASH.name: Jash Engineering
lines: Order book at ₹944 cr after ₹102 cr September orders (₹66 cr in August), driven by water-infrastructure and international demand.
Saudi Arabia plant cleared all approvals, with land application next; Saudi and Houston plants due by FY28, targeting ₹1,500 cr revenue by FY31.

AVADHSUGAR.name: Avadh Sugar & Energy
lines: No confirmed company-specific catalyst found for October 2026; only sector chatter on ethanol diversion (~3 mn tonnes) and undecided 2026-27 sugar export policy.

DPABHUSHAN.name: D. P. Abhushan
lines: Board on Oct 5 approved a ₹558 cr preferential issue (8.66 lakh shares plus 30.36 lakh warrants at ₹1,430) for inventory and retail expansion into Gujarat and newer markets.
Shareholder vote at EoGM on Oct 29; promoter stake would fall from 74.89% to 66.46% on full conversion.

SHANTIGOLD.name: Shanti Gold International
lines: Capacity addition of about 4,000 kg a year (₹8.5 cr capex, internal accruals): Mumbai Marol plant commissioned June 2026, Jaipur plant due by September; completion targeted Q2 FY27.
Rights issue of up to ₹99.83 cr at ₹215 (19:295; record date Aug 6) closed in August.

CHENNPETRO.name: Chennai Petroleum
lines: Manali refinery expansion planned from 2.1 to 2.8 lakh bpd (+33%); Nagapattinam 9 MMTPA Cauvery Basin project reconfigured toward petrochemicals (IOC 75% stake).
Manali expansion feasibility study due October 2026; board approval and cost not yet confirmed.

DCMSRIND.name: DCM Shriram Industries
lines: No company-specific catalyst found; stock fell to about ₹38 in October. Capex news found belongs to the separate DCM Shriram Ltd.

PASHUPATI.name: Pashupati Cotspin
lines: No catalyst found: only 2026 stock split and authorised capital raise to ₹16 crore; no order, capex or export news.

ACUTAAS.name: Acutaas Chemicals
lines: CDMO revenue target pulled forward to ₹1,000 crore in FY27 (from FY28); four new CDMO molecules launching H2FY27; FY27 capex raised to about ₹300 crore for battery electrolyte additives and Surat pilot plant.
27 Oct 2026: FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 30% from 25%.

MENONBE.name: Menon Bearings
lines: No fresh catalyst found for the late-Oct/early-Nov jump (+9.45% on 30 Oct, +15% intraday 2 Nov); no order, deal or approval located.

SHREEPUSHK.name: Shree Pushkar Chemicals
lines: Board approved ₹70 cr Unit-5 Ratnagiri plant adding 3,000 MTPA capacity, targeted for commissioning by March 2028.
₹45 cr promoter preferential warrant issue goes to EGM vote on 2 Dec 2026; Unit-5 dyes expansion lifted dyes capacity to 6,000 MTPA.

SHRINGARMS.name: Shringar House of Mangalsutra
lines: No fresh catalyst found for the recent move; likely momentum or sector flow.

ORIENTHOT.name: Oriental Hotels
lines: Tata-group IHCL to absorb Oriental Hotels in a 25:117 share swap (board-approved Aug 24, 2026), about an 8.5% premium to prior close.
Appointed date Apr 1, 2027; completion targeted H2 FY28, subject to NCLT, shareholder and SEBI approvals.
